action: No security action is indicated. Workday customers: confirm that payroll runs, time entries and scheduled integrations from the evening of November 13 completed correctly, and watch Workday's status updates for the cause.
exec: A payroll and HR supplier outage of unknown cause; a reminder to have a fallback for time-critical pay runs.
plain: An outage on the evening of November 13 stopped many employees from signing in to Workday's payroll and staff-management service. Workday gave no cause and nothing points to an attack.
summary: A widespread outage on the evening of November 13 locked users out of Workday's payroll and HR platform, with nearly 3,000 Downdetector reports shortly after 5 p.m. ET. Workday called it a service disruption under investigation and gave no cause. The company serves about 11,500 organizations; not all were affected. Cyber cause: not indicated.
title: Workday outage locks employees out of payroll and HR systems
